disclaimer: Synthetic educational dataset created for a Cyber GRC portfolio project. The schema is simplified and is not an export of any real AWS account or a reproduction of an official AWS service response format.

findings.title: Customer-data bucket allows public access
findings.description: A storage bucket containing customer information is configured in a way that permits public access.
evidence: S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled
Bucket policy permits access broader than the approved business requirement
findings.business_context: The bucket stores customer information used by the e-commerce platform.
recommended_actions: Remove unnecessary public bucket policies and ACLs
Restrict access through IAM roles and least privilege
Classify the data and review encryption requirements

findings.title: IAM role contains excessive administrative permissions
findings.description: An operations role has permissions broader than those required for its documented business function.
evidence: Role contains broad permissions across multiple AWS services
No recent entitlement review is documented
findings.business_context: The role is used by personnel supporting daily e-commerce operations.
recommended_actions: Review actual permissions required by the role
Remove unused or overly broad permissions

findings.title: MFA is not enabled for privileged human access
findings.description: A privileged human identity can access the AWS environment without multi-factor authentication.
evidence: No MFA device is associated with the identity
findings.business_context: The identity can perform administrative actions in production resources.
recommended_actions: Prefer federation and temporary credentials for human users

findings.title: Potential personal data detected without documented classification
findings.description: Potential personal data was identified in a bucket that does not have a documented classification, owner, or retention rule.
evidence: No classification tag is associated with the dataset
No documented data owner or retention schedule
findings.business_context: The archive contains historical e-commerce order information.

findings.title: Audit logging coverage is incomplete
findings.description: The current audit logging configuration does not provide the desired centralized coverage and monitoring for security investigations.
evidence: Logging coverage is not aligned with the defined multi-account monitoring baseline
Centralized alerting for relevant events is not documented
findings.business_context: Audit logs are required to investigate suspicious activity and support accountability.
recommended_actions: Review CloudTrail coverage across accounts and Regions
Integrate relevant events with monitoring and alerting

findings.title: High-severity findings exceed remediation target
findings.description: Multiple high-severity security findings remain open without documented ownership or remediation deadlines.
evidence: Finding owners are not consistently assigned
No formal remediation SLA is recorded
findings.business_context: Management lacks consistent visibility into overdue cybersecurity remediation activities.
recommended_actions: Define remediation SLAs based on severity
Track findings through a workflow or ticketing process
Escalate overdue critical and high findings
Include remediation metrics in governance reporting
